title: Post-depth evidence synthesis and FMA eligibility audit
summary: Fixed depth rejection is mapped into all reference-history mirrors. Full disk ledger has 42 unique items: four manuscript groups and 38 reference-only histories. The remaining ICCV2025 FMA lead explicitly trains both encoders in author code, so direct reuse is excluded from the frozen-feature comparison. No new method is selected; next unit consolidates retained-stack and target evidence before a contribution judgment.
limitations: Full FMA PDF access failed; eligibility conclusion relies on primary abstract and full author training entrypoint, not numerical claims.
Reference history count is not independent evidence count.
No new accuracy, novelty or submission-readiness claim.
